tokens.name: brand-mint
tokens.usage: The logo's left half. Primary button fill, selected tree row marker, Begin node, focus glow. Fill only: never text. Text on it is `on-brand`.

tokens.name: brand-cyan
tokens.usage: The logo's right half. Equipment nodes, connection lines on the canvas, Deploy actions. Fill only: never text. Text on it is `on-brand`.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `brand-mint` and `brand-cyan` fills, in both themes (12:1 and 9.2:1).

tokens.name: mint-text
tokens.usage: Mint as text or a 1–2px line: links, active tab label, Procedure node type label. On `bg`, `surface`, `raised` (≥4.75:1 light, ≥11:1 dark).

tokens.name: cyan-text
tokens.usage: Cyan as text or a line: Equipment node type label, info messages, the focus ring. On `bg`, `surface`, `raised` (≥5.2:1 light, ≥9.2:1 dark).

tokens.name: mint-soft
tokens.usage: Approved badge ground, selected row in the hierarchy tree. Pair with `mint-text`.

tokens.name: cyan-soft
tokens.usage: Info banners, drop-target highlight on the canvas. Pair with `cyan-text`.

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background behind panels (login, home, the designer frame).

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Panels, modals, cards, canvas nodes, inputs.

tokens.name: raised
tokens.usage: Menu bar, toolbar, table headers, hovered rows.

tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: The workflow canvas ground.

tokens.name: canvas-dot
tokens.usage: The canvas dot grid, one dot every `space-5`.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairlines between panels, card and table borders. Decorative only.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Input and secondary-button borders; anything that marks a control (≥3:1 on `surface`).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body text and headings on `bg`, `surface`, `raised`, `canvas`. Also the logo outline and Begin/End node fill (light).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: metadata, helper text, timestamps, placeholder. On `bg`, `surface`, `raised` (≥5.8:1 light, ≥6.1:1 dark).

tokens.name: status-draft-bg
tokens.usage: Draft badge ground.

tokens.name: status-draft-fg
tokens.usage: Draft badge text, on `status-draft-bg`.

tokens.name: status-review-bg
tokens.usage: Pending review badge ground.

tokens.name: status-review-fg
tokens.usage: Pending review badge text and warning text, on `status-review-bg` or `surface`.

tokens.name: status-changes-bg
tokens.usage: Changes requested badge ground; error banner ground.

tokens.name: status-changes-fg
tokens.usage: Changes requested badge text, validation errors, destructive buttons. On `status-changes-bg` or `surface`.

tokens.name: status-approved-bg
tokens.usage: Approved badge ground.

tokens.name: status-approved-fg
tokens.usage: Approved badge text, on `status-approved-bg`.

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: The name beside the mark in the menu bar. Always uppercase.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Panel headers, section headers in modals.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Drag a definition onto the canvas to add it to the workflow.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Form labels, buttons, tree rows, node titles.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Compiled XML, IDs, parameter values, units.

styles.name: overline
styles.usage: Node type labels on the canvas and tree group labels. Uppercase.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, badge vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Button vertical padding, gaps inside a node, tree row padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Button horizontal padding, input padding, node padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Panel padding, gaps between form fields.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Modal padding, canvas grid pitch.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gaps between page sections; login card padding.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, buttons, tree rows, node type chip.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Canvas nodes, cards, menus.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Modals and the login card.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Status badges and Begin/End nodes.

tokens.usage: Nodes resting on the canvas.
